security_cases: oversized input is rejected before expensive work
text supplied by users is rendered with textContent rather than injected HTML
NaN, Infinity and numeric overflow paths produce explicit errors
export names are fixed safe filenames and generated content cannot choose a filesystem path
JSON import above 200 KB is rejected
malformed snapshots are rejected without overwriting current data
responsive_accessibility_cases: 320px viewport: controls remain single-column and primary action reachable without horizontal page scrolling
keyboard-only: all interactive controls have visible focus and usable labels
screen reader: result container uses role=status and aria-live=polite
reduced motion: no essential information depends on animation
copy/export/download behavior is user initiated and local
performance_cases: worst supported input remains bounded by explicit row/period limits
no network request is required for calculation
